# Santo Domingo SEO

> Santo Domingo SEO (santodomingoseo.com) helps businesses in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic get found on Google and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. The site is bilingual (English and Spanish via an on-page toggle) and offers a free audit.

## Pages
- [Home](https://santodomingoseo.com/): SEO, AI optimization (AIO), industries served, service area and FAQ for Santo Domingo businesses

## Related sites in the Dominican Republic
- [SEO Dominican Republic](https://seodominicanrepublic.com/): national Dominican Republic coverage

## Key facts
- Run by Eye To Ad Media, a digital marketing agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, in business since 2012
- No ranking guarantees; clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638 (toll-free), WhatsApp +1 720-249-6588, info@eyetoad.com, or the form at https://santodomingoseo.com/
